subject: financial_literacy
concept: Final mastery check and reflection on the complete K-12 financial literacy journey, confirming readiness for financial independence
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative capstone review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Student reviews a timeline of their own financial literacy journey from first coins through capstone independence planning
exercise.abstract: Student completes a comprehensive capstone assessment drawing on budgeting, banking, credit, investing, wealth-building, and entrepreneurship skills, and reflects in writing on their readiness for financial independence

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed capstone question types, plus a passing independent financial plan and reflection
misconception_flags: any capstone-unit misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
next_node_on_fail: FINLIT.G12.CAPSTONE_INDEPENDENCE.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
